decisions.reason: F2 overstates the spectral theorem by including the norm formula. Replaced that attribution with its actual eigenbasis interface and proved norm preservation directly from the bit-flip basis permutation, then bounded J on each vector. Prefix-XOR conjugation, normalized Hamming-layer counts and the explicit sign eigenbasis establish the unchanged transfer and norm statement without AC.

The Chebyshev recurrence at k=0 referred to undefined T_{-1}. Restricted that recurrence to k>=1 while retaining k>=0 for the absolutely convergent Bessel series. Initial values, scalar target and normalization are unchanged; the defect is an indexing error rather than a failed simulation claim.

Step 1.2 mislabeled the scalar matrix-entry supplier as F4. F5 explicitly supplies the full polynomial matrix with determinant (-1)^d; corrected that reference and tag. Direct multiplication verifies F^2=I, clean compression K/alpha, the qubiterate rotation, paired-space QSP order and controlled i^d convention; no statement or phase convention changed.

F2 incorrectly attributes query-model conventions to a circuit encoding. Declared the input-independent initial state, inter-query unitaries and final measured output bit locally, checked against Beals et al. section 3.2 and complete Lemmas 4.1-4.2 proofs. The amplitude degree induction and Boolean-character orthogonality prove the unchanged n/2 bound, including n=0; no uniformity premise is used.

The exact n=2 weights 1/sqrt(2) and normalization sqrt(2) are correct, as is the eigenvalue calculation giving exp(-i*pi*H0)|0>=-|2>. F3 and step 2.1 falsely identified this matrix with the rounded lower-bound family, whose n=2 weights are 23/32. Corrected the distinction and scoped the lower bound to row-location/value XOR access, leaving the exact example intact.

The nontrivial branch could receive only a block matrix and one comparison, although OP4 requires actual inverse/controlled access, circuit and cost declarations, scalar interval routines and rational epsilon. This left an algorithm call undefined on declared admissible inputs. Added all exact-mode OP4 prerequisites explicitly for that branch, preserving identity behavior, failure propagation and every cost coordinate.

The original title implied an optimality result beyond the correctness statement. Renamed it Qubitized simulation correctness, and removed the extra functional-calculus attribution from F8 while spelling out the diagonal scalar-to-operator norm estimate. Checked the 3rho+2delta+8d sqrt(epsilon_BE) budget, 10sqrt(eta) OAA leakage bound, remaining epsilon/64 telescoping allowance and trace-distance supplier. The mathematical statement remains unchanged.

F1 explicitly invokes OP4 through the wrapper. The invoked algorithm Definition steps 3-4 specify two real QSVT extractions, and step 5 explicitly gives -W R W* R W. Hence F3 per-sequence counts sum to 3(d_E+d_O) signal positions and 6(d_E+d_O+2) controlled reflections; odd-degree selection replaces one signal per odd sequence with its controlled version. The actual interface supplies the allegedly absent structure, so no edit is needed.
